DealRecordingSnapshot.description: The recorder as the chrome reads it, on the wire.

counter_stale.description:
The counter has not moved for the stale span while prints kept
coming — REC on (state `stale`) or off, where the chart's chip says
`counter stale` or `counter stuck at 0` (`session_deals` 0).

deal_count_available.description: Whether a `trades` pane has a count to cut on right now.

error.description: The last write or read error, if the recorder hit one.

file.description: The file being written, while recording.

first_reading_unix_ms.description: When the first reading of this run arrived, written to a file or not.

loaded_days.description: Days whose readings were loaded into the panes this session.

record_by_default.description:
The standing choice: record by default wherever a feed carries a
counter — what the Tools menu's checkbox reads, saved with the
workspace.

recorded_days.description: Days recorded under this symbol, oldest first.

samples_written.description: Lines written to that file this run.

session_deals.description: The newest reading of the venue's session deal counter.

since_unix_ms.description:
Where the open file starts, on the tape's clock — the recording's own
"since", resumed or written this run. What the REC button shows.

state.description:
`off`, `recording`, `stale` (the tape flows, the counter does not),
`recorded` (the readings on screen came from a file) or `unsupported`
(the feed declares no counter; a day recorded earlier may still be
listed and loaded).

from_open.description: Whether the recording started with the counter barely begun.

session_deals.description: The counter's last reading that day.

description: What the call did: the tab, and the recorder as it stands afterwards.

recording.description:
`None` when the tab's feed has no deal counter — the call changed
nothing, and says so rather than failing.

title: DealRecordingResult
